name: Question 12
worked_solution:
The formula for the derivative of arctangent is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arctan}⁡x)=\frac{1}{1+{x}^{2}}.
$$

Using the chain rule and the formula above, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({arctan}^{2}⁡(3{e}^{x})) \\  & =2\operatorname{arctan}⁡(3{e}^{x})\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arctan}⁡(3{e}^{x})) \\  & =2\operatorname{arctan}⁡(3{e}^{x})\cdot \frac{1}{1+{(3{e}^{x})}^{2}}\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(3{e}^{x}) \\  & =2\operatorname{arctan}⁡(3{e}^{x})\cdot \frac{1}{1+9{e}^{2x}}\cdot 3{e}^{x} \\  & =\frac{6{e}^{x}\operatorname{arctan}⁡(3{e}^{x})}{1+9{e}^{2x}}.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 12
?

Calculate f′(x) for f(x)=arctan2⁡(3ex).

a
3exarctan⁡(3ex)1+e2x
b
arctan⁡(3ex)1+9e2x
c
6exarctan⁡(3ex)1+9e2x
d
6ex1+9e2x
e
2exarctan⁡(3ex)1+3e2x
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The formula for the derivative of arctangent is ddx(arctan⁡x)=11+x2.

Using the chain rule and the formula above, we get f′(x)=ddx(arctan2⁡(3ex))=2arctan⁡(3ex)⋅ddx(arctan⁡(3ex))=2arctan⁡(3ex)⋅11+(3ex)2⋅ddx(3ex)=2arctan⁡(3ex)⋅11+9e2x⋅3ex=6exarctan⁡(3ex)1+9e2x.
